title: TNI²TRI Assessment
subtitle: More Than a Questionnaire
intro: TNI²TRI is an adaptive diagnostic process, not a standard one-size-fits-all questionnaire. The assessment begins with a structured baseline and progressively adapts according to the organisation's context and responses.

assessmentLogic.title: Assessment Logic

flow.name: Classification
flow.desc: Algorithmic categorization of maturity and risk signals

flow.name: Next Question
flow.desc: Dynamic branching to targeted deeper exploration

flow.name: Evidence
flow.desc: Verification and grounding of claims against data

assessmentLogic.philosophy: The objective is not to ask more questions. The objective is to ask the right questions.

evidenceValidation.title: Evidence & Validation
evidenceValidation.headline: The assessment distinguishes between what the organisation reports and what available evidence demonstrates.

levels.title: Unverified
levels.description: Self-reported information without sufficient supporting evidence.
levels.implication: Baseline hypothesis requiring validation prior to resource commitment.

levels.title: Supported
levels.implication: Initial documentation or anecdotal verification exists; further corroboration recommended.

levels.title: Corroborated
levels.description: Multiple sources or evidence support the finding.
levels.implication: High confidence backed by cross-departmental data, KPI logs, and process audits.

levels.title: Verified
levels.implication: Empirical ground truth validated through independent verification, automated telemetry, and historical audits.

diagnosticIntelligence.title: Diagnostic Intelligence
diagnosticIntelligence.subtitle: The assessment investigates:

pipeline.question: What is the present observable operational reality?
What is missing or lagging compared to target industrial benchmarks?
Why does this gap exist structurally, procedurally, or culturally?
What other functions, systems, or capabilities are linked to this issue?
How severely does this bottleneck restrict enterprise throughput and value?
What concrete, sequenced intervention must occur to resolve it sustainably?

diagnosticIntelligence.highlight: The objective is not merely to identify weaknesses. The objective is to understand why they exist, what they affect and what should happen next.

readiness.title: Transformation Readiness
readiness.subtitle: Readiness is evaluated across eight strategic pillars:

pillars.name: Strategy
pillars.desc: Clarity of strategic direction and executive commitment

pillars.name: Organisation
pillars.desc: Structural agility, cross-functional coordination, and governance

pillars.name: Technology
pillars.desc: Digital backbone, system interoperability, and data integrity

pillars.name: People
pillars.desc: Workforce skills, training infrastructure, and change appetite

pillars.name: Finance
pillars.desc: Capital availability, CapEx governance, and cash flow cushion

pillars.name: Resources
pillars.desc: Physical infrastructure, equipment bandwidth, and partner networks

pillars.name: Risk & Leadership
pillars.desc: Enterprise resilience, crisis response, and executive sponsorship

scale.name: Not Ready
scale.description: Unprepared; fundamental prerequisite structural clarity or leadership mandate is missing.

scale.name: Aware
scale.description: Recognizes the need to evolve; gaps are acknowledged but unstructured.

scale.name: Preparing
scale.description: Initial resource alignment, baseline reviews, and scoping underway.

scale.name: Ready
scale.description: Operational foundations and governance in place for targeted execution.

scale.name: Transformation Ready
scale.description: High maturity, evidence-backed capabilities, and cross-functional momentum established.

scale.name: Transformation Capable
scale.description: Institutionalized agility; continuous learning, rapid pivoting, and self-renewal.
